dialogues.speaker: Sukhrab
dialogues.text: The Shock-Boiling Device is in good condition. Its restraint components should be able to withstand another nineteen days of high-intensity operation... That will be sufficient.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: Interested? This is an alchemical mechanism known as the Shock-Boiling Device, designed to greatly enhance one's combat capabilities.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: As long as you possess a certain degree of fighting ability to begin with, it can bring out combat power on par with a seasoned veteran.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: And if you, like me, have tempered yourself through rigorous training and battle, then once you use it, you'll be able to perform at one hundred and twenty percent in every fight.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: Sounds good, doesn't it? You can place an order with me now. Once I return to Sumeru, I'll let Professor Hajanad know, and she can arrange for the workshop to fit your order into the schedule.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: That's only natural. The Professor once said the device was created with "the help of the most brilliant person in the world," and that the experience felt "like two of the most wonderful dreams."

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: As the Akademiya gradually comes to recognize her academic achievements, I'm sure her story will reach more and more people.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: And once her work earns the recognition it deserves, she'll be able to help even more people with that kind heart of hers...

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: ...If only her silly grin weren't so terrifying, she'd be perfect.

choices.text: I don't know what it is, and I'm not interested.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: Then you're passing up something valuable. Even the Corps of Thirty has started equipping a small number of its members with the Shock-Boiling Device, you know.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: I'm sure Professor Hajanad will keep improving it until it's as affordable and reliable as a scimitar — a piece of support equipment that can help protect Sumeru even better.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: That's right. Didn't think you'd be able to tell at a glance.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: I used to live north of Port Ormos, making my living as a hunter. Back then, I hadn't seen much of the world...

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: Then I was fortunate enough to take on a temporary commission, escorting some scholars through an area crowded with Fungi while they carried out their research. That was when Professor Hajanad noticed me, and invited me to study under her at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: That was how I came to assist with her research and take on all kinds of adventuring commissions.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: And now, with the Shock-Boiling Device's help, I've completed 137 A-rank commissions.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: I may not have any extraordinary achievements, like clearing an S-rank commission, but I've always made up for it with diligence. That's how I earned the Guild's recommendation and came here to compete with Captain Lemta's team.

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: I just hope my final results will make the Professor proud...

response.speaker: Sukhrab
response.text: Oh? Well... until next time, then?
